text:
anya: Heads-up — ArcaneModels sent a draft licensing + distribution note for their new Llama-derivative. They want co-brand, attribution, and a limited redistribution window for partner marketplaces. Need quick sync on what we can accept for Redwood Marketplace and Dedicated deployments.

mike: link to draft: https://drive.redwood/arcane/draft-v1 (read-only)

sanjay: quick eng note — their model checkpoints are large (~45GB fp16). If redistribution requires us to host weight bundles, we need to lock in quantization and packaging format (QLoRA vs 8-bit). Also need clarity on whether we can offer a hosted copy in our Dedicated offering.

laura: @anya can you confirm desired go-to-market? my assumption: 1) list on Redwood Marketplace with joint listing 2) optional Dedicated/Private deployment for enterprise customers 3) joint press/launch. We should ask partner for revenue share ask and any timeline constraints.

fred_legal: skimmed the draft. High-level comments: 1) their current clause allows redistribution to "approved marketplaces" but has a broad sublicensing grant — request to narrow to "distribution as hosted service" only. 2) export controls: include an explicit export compliance warranty and list of allowed jurisdictions. 3) indemnity cap language is currently open-ended; suggest we cap and add mutual indemnity for IP claims.

anya: copying their exact snippet for context:

```
Section 4.2 Redistribution: Partner grants Redwood a non-exclusive, sublicensable license to redistribute, modify, and host Model Artifacts as part of Redwood's platform and marketplace. Redistribution to third-party endpoints requires Partner approval. Term: 18 months from delivery.
```

anya: Their 18-month term is unusual — maybe they want to limit rehosting. We should ask if that applies to hosted inference (we'd need longer for committed Dedicated customers).

mike: ops question — if we host their artifact on Redwood Hosted, will we need to keep the exact artifact or can we accept a converted/quantized derivative (we prefer quantized derivative to reduce egress/cost). They may be sensitive to "modified" language.

fred_legal: suggest this reply: narrow license to "hosting and serving for Redwood customers and Marketplace listings, including derivative formats created solely for deployment efficiency (e.g., quantization), provided original author is credited." Add a clause: "Customer-facing redistribution (downloads) is not permitted without explicit written approval." Also change term to "perpetual for durations of active listing or contract with an enterprise customer."

laura: commercial ask — partners usually expect 10–30% revenue share for marketplace listing + co-marketing. We should propose a standard Redwood marketplace offer: 20% platform fee on transactions, optional co-marketing budget split (50/50 up to $10k). Will check if Arcane expects anything different.

anya: getting verbal from Arcane PM: they prefer platform fee + a small upfront listing fee rather than revenue share. Also they want a joint announcement but want the press embargo aligned with their upcoming model paper (6 weeks out).

sanjay: operational constraints: embargo means we need to keep package private for 6 weeks. For Dedicated customers who contract in that window, we must support private deployment without public listing. That's doable but we should record it as an exception in the contract.

mike: tagging infra: @sanjay — we might need one-off packaging script to produce a quantized bundle and a checksum so partner can verify the derivative. Also need an S3 staging policy for embargoed artifacts.

partners-bot: Created task PM-402: "ArcaneModels marketplace onboarding — contract & packaging" assigned to laura, due in 5 business days.

anya: Proposed next steps: 1) Legal to send tracked-change reply with limited sublicense + export clause + perpetual-for-active-listing wording (fred to draft) 2) Partnerships to propose platform-fee-first commercial term (laura) 3) Eng to confirm quantization packaging requirements and produce an artifact checklist (sanjay/mike) 4) Ops to confirm embargo staging (mike).

fred_legal: will draft redline and aim to send within 48 hours.

laura: I'll draft the commercial term sheet and ping Arcane to confirm whether they prefer listing fee vs rev share.

sanjay: I'll prototype the quantization checklist (format, checksum, sample inference test) and post it here when done.

anya: Great — let's reconvene after redline. If anyone hits blockers, drop notes here or create threads per document. :thumbsup:
